step5_question.question_previous_version: According to NIKE, Inc.'s Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended May 31, 2026, what percentage of total NIKE Brand revenues in fiscal 2026 was contributed by each of North America; Europe, Middle East & Africa (EMEA); Greater China; Asia Pacific & Latin America (APLA); and Global Brand Divisions, and which contributed the largest share? Report percentages to two decimal places.
step5_question.gt_template:
To calculate the percentage of revenue contributed by each region to Nike's total revenue in 2026:

Formula:
Percentage of Revenue = (Revenue from Region / Total NIKE Brand Revenue) x 100

Data:

North America Revenue = $[[NA@FY2026]] million
EMEA Revenue = $[[EMEA@FY2026]] million
Greater China Revenue = $[[GC@FY2026]] million
APLA Revenue = $[[APLA@FY2026]] million
Global Brand Divisions Revenue = $[[GBD@FY2026]] million
Total NIKE Brand Revenue = $[[NA@FY2026]] + $[[EMEA@FY2026]] + $[[GC@FY2026]] + $[[APLA@FY2026]] + $[[GBD@FY2026]] = $[[Brand@FY2026]] million
Calculations:

North America: ([[NA@FY2026]] / [[Brand@FY2026]]) x 100 = [[ShareNA@FY2026|.2f]]%
EMEA: ([[EMEA@FY2026]] / [[Brand@FY2026]]) x 100 = [[ShareEMEA@FY2026|.2f]]%
Greater China: ([[GC@FY2026]] / [[Brand@FY2026]]) x 100 = [[ShareGC@FY2026|.2f]]%
APLA: ([[APLA@FY2026]] / [[Brand@FY2026]]) x 100 = [[ShareAPLA@FY2026|.2f]]%
Global Brand Divisions: ([[GBD@FY2026]] / [[Brand@FY2026]]) x 100 = [[ShareGBD@FY2026|.2f]]%

North America contributes the largest share, followed by EMEA, APLA and Greater China, so NIKE Brand revenue remains concentrated in North America and EMEA. (Total NIKE, Inc. revenues, including Converse, were $[[TotRev@FY2026]] million; measured against that total, North America's share is [[NA@FY2026 / TotRev@FY2026 * 100|.2f]]%.)
